jobs.description: Looking for a logistics role in a state-of-the-art high-tech environment? Join an innovative organisation and help keep tomorrow’s technology moving. Wie zoeken we? MBO Level 2 or 3 diploma in Logistics or a related field At least 2 years of experience in logistics or a similar working environment Valid EPT certificate Interest in logistics processes within a high-tech environment Good command of the English language Willingness to work in a two-shift schedule Willingness and ability to travel to the Eindhoven region for work It is desirable that you work accurately and independently and have a strong focus on quality. You are proactive, hands-on and flexible when it comes to different tasks and departments. You communicate effectively, take responsibility for your work and enjoy working together with colleagues in a dynamic and international environment. Wat bieden wij je? Gross monthly salary of approximately €4,023, including 25.1% shift allowance and 0.65% ADV allowance 8% holiday allowance 13th month salary Annual bonus based on company results 27 vacation days per year Travel reimbursement Working in a modern and internationally renowned high-tech environment Opportunities to work across different logistics departments and processes Long-term career and development opportunities A professional and international working environment where innovation, quality and teamwork are central Functieomschrijving For an internationally renowned high-tech organisation, we are looking for motivated and experienced Logistics Employees. This vacancy is advertised in the Weert region; however, the work will also take place in the Eindhoven region. Therefore, it is essential that you are willing and able to travel to the Eindhoven region for work. You will work in a modern and dynamic high-tech environment where logistics plays a crucial role in the overall production process. There are several departments and logistics teams within the organisation. Based on your experience,skills and interests, we will look together at which department and role suits you best. As a Logistics Employee, you contribute to the smooth and efficient flow of materials, components and products. Depending on your department, your responsibilities may vary, but accuracy, quality and teamwork are always essential. Your responsibilities may include: Transporting and moving materials and components within the facility Preparing materials and products for production or further processing Checking materials for quality, completeness and correctness Loading and unloading incoming and outgoing goods Managing and organising materials, tools and components Cleaning and packing products according to established procedures Working with logistics equipment such as an EPT Supporting colleagues with various logistics activities Following strict quality, safety and working procedures Contributing to an efficient and well-organised logistics process

Become a blade specialist at Redak Work at impressive locations in the Netherlands and abroad, learn all about wind turbines and be part of a close-knit team that makes a difference every day. Don't have the right qualifications yet? No problem. At Redak, we'll train you internally to become a fully qualified blade specialist.  About Redak  Redak is a leading Dutch company with over 30 years of experience in inspecting, maintaining, and repairing wind turbine blades. We provide service solutions for wind farms worldwide, with a strong focus on safety, sustainability, and innovation. Our strength? An experienced team and the drive to contribute to reliable, green energy every day.  As a blade specialist, you play a key role in our daily operations. You inspect and repair damage to wind turbines and provide technical advice on the smartest service and maintenance solutions.  A challenging and varied role in which you contribute to the quality and safety of sustainable energy. And to Redak's reputation as a specialist in the wind industry. You'll work at height and travel for projects both nationally and internationally, on land and at sea. Our head office is located in Alkmaar. Your workspace? It changes every day.  What you get from us...  - Paid training and certifications - Work at heights, outdoors - Reimbursement for hotels and meals - Additional compensation for overtime - A close-knit and committed team - Projects in the Netherlands, Belgium, and Germany - The opportunity to help build a more sustainable world  You are...  - Between 18 and 40 years old - Technical, practical, and adventurous - Living in the Netherlands - Fluent in both Dutch and English
